## Changes made

### `src/slugkit/unique.py` (new)
Implements `unique_slug(text, existing)`:
1. Computes `base = slugify(text)`
2. Returns `base` if not in `existing`
3. Otherwise tries `base~2`, `base~3`, … — trimming the base so the full result stays within `SLUG_MAX`, and stripping any trailing `~` from the trimmed base before appending the suffix

### `src/slugkit/__init__.py`
Added `from slugkit.unique import unique_slug` so it's importable as `from slugkit import unique_slug`.

### `tests/test_unique.py` (new)
Tests covering every rule from the spec:
- Free slug returned unchanged
- Taken slug gets `~2` suffix, then `~3`, etc.
- `existing` set is never modified
- `EMPTY_SLUG` base still gets suffixed when taken (`n~a~2`)
- Result never exceeds `SLUG_MAX`
- Base is trimmed (trailing `~` stripped) to make room for the suffix
- Input is slugified before comparison (not raw text)
- `unique_slug` is importable from top-level `slugkit`","time":{"start":1794697729470,"end":1794697735690}}}
